# Toeplitz Matrix.

@example Each row is the row above it moved one place to the right, with a new number coming in at the left, so the six slants hold 2, 5, 3, 6, 0 and 8.
[[6,0,8],[3,6,0],[5,3,6],[2,5,3]]
=> true

@example Every slant holds one number except the one that starts at the 0 in the left column, which goes on to a 6.
[[4,1,7,5,2],[0,4,1,7,5],[3,6,4,1,7]]
=> false

@example In a single row every slant is one cell long.
[[8,0,8,5]]
=> true

# The smallest matrix.
[[0]]
=> true

# A single column of 20: every slant is one cell, however the numbers differ.
[[0],[99],[41],[7],[63],[18],[85],[2],[50],[33],[96],[12],[71],[29],[58],[4],[90],[26],[67],[15]]
=> true

# Constant along the lines that run down and to the left, but not along the
# slants.
[[10,20,30],[20,30,40]]
=> false

# Constant along the slants, but not along the lines that run down and to
# the left.
[[10,20,30],[40,10,20]]
=> true

# Every number the same, the largest allowed.
[[99,99],[99,99],[99,99]]
=> true

# Wide and tall: a Toeplitz matrix of 3 rows of 17, then one of 17 rows of 3
# whose only mismatch is in the last row.
[[31,8,77,54,0,19,62,45,93,26,70,13,88,39,5,66,24],[47,31,8,77,54,0,19,62,45,93,26,70,13,88,39,5,66],[81,47,31,8,77,54,0,19,62,45,93,26,70,13,88,39,5]]
=> true

[[52,57,18],[9,52,57],[74,9,52],[36,74,9],[88,36,74],[21,88,36],[60,21,88],[3,60,21],[95,3,60],[47,95,3],[14,47,95],[79,14,47],[30,79,14],[66,30,79],[11,66,30],[83,11,66],[40,44,11]]
=> false

# The only mismatch is on a slant that starts in the left column, below the
# top row: 9, then 6.
[[5,1,8,2],[3,5,1,8],[9,3,5,1],[4,6,3,5]]
=> false

# The only mismatch is on a slant that starts in the top row, right of the
# corner, and it is in the last column: 1, 1, then 0.
[[5,1,8,2],[3,5,1,8],[9,3,5,0],[4,9,3,5]]
=> false

# The first and last cells of a slant agree, but not the middle one: 3, 8, 3.
[[3,1,6],[2,8,1],[5,2,3]]
=> false

# A long slant whose first two cells agree: 4, 4, 6, 6, 6.
[[4,15,16,17,18],[14,4,15,16,17],[13,14,6,15,16],[12,13,14,6,15],[11,12,13,14,6]]
=> false

# A slant whose numbers add up to three times its first, 5 + 4 + 6.
[[5,0,9],[1,4,0],[2,1,6]]
=> false

# The largest matrix, 20 by 20, with its only mismatch in the bottom right
# cell.
[[59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8,56,54,4,33,80,13,40,37,35,48],[73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8,56,54,4,33,80,13,40,37,35],[84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8,56,54,4,33,80,13,40,37],[83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8,56,54,4,33,80,13,40],[95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8,56,54,4,33,80,13],[99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8,56,54,4,33,80],[92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8,56,54,4,33],[43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8,56,54,4],[12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8,56,54],[65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8,56],[70,65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54,8],[39,70,65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26,54],[18,39,70,65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4,26],[90,18,39,70,65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76,4],[88,90,18,39,70,65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59,76],[42,88,90,18,39,70,65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36,59],[35,42,88,90,18,39,70,65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45,36],[44,35,42,88,90,18,39,70,65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78,45],[28,44,35,42,88,90,18,39,70,65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,59,78],[35,28,44,35,42,88,90,18,39,70,65,12,43,92,99,95,83,84,73,9]]
=> false

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
[[3,0,2],[0,2,3]]
=> false

@gen 4 small
[[0,2,1,0],[2,0,2,1],[1,2,0,2]]
=> true

@gen 5 small
[[1,1,2,1,2],[0,2,0,2,0],[1,3,2,3,3]]
=> false

@gen 6 small
[[3,0,3,2],[1,3,0,3],[0,1,3,0],[3,0,1,3]]
=> true

@gen 8 small
[[1,3,3],[3,1,3],[0,3,1],[1,3,3],[0,1,0]]
=> false

@gen 13 small
[[3,2,1,1,1],[1,3,2,1,1],[0,1,3,2,1],[0,0,1,3,2],[1,0,0,1,3]]
=> true

@gen 15 small
[[2,3],[3,0],[2,0],[1,0],[0,0]]
=> false

# Full-size random cases: a 20 by 20 Toeplitz matrix, and two with one
# changed cell near the end, in the last column and in the last row.
@gen 14
[[10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71,83,9,55,83,11,13,6,83,14,43],[83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71,83,9,55,83,11,13,6,83,14],[65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71,83,9,55,83,11,13,6,83],[16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71,83,9,55,83,11,13,6],[52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71,83,9,55,83,11,13],[51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71,83,9,55,83,11],[92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71,83,9,55,83],[87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71,83,9,55],[85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71,83,9],[93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71,83],[31,93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99,71],[92,31,93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38,99],[96,92,31,93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62,38],[42,96,92,31,93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85,62],[25,42,96,92,31,93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78,85],[52,25,42,96,92,31,93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98,78],[71,52,25,42,96,92,31,93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45,98],[41,71,52,25,42,96,92,31,93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11,45],[64,41,71,52,25,42,96,92,31,93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10,11],[30,64,41,71,52,25,42,96,92,31,93,85,87,92,51,52,16,65,83,10]]
